name: Revive Phoenix
description: Born from ash and undying will, Revive Phoenix rises every time it falls. Its blazing wings carry the fire of resurrection — an eternal guardian that refuses to be extinguished.

ability.name: Blazing Rebirth
ability.description: When Phoenix uses its Special, it erupts in sacred flame: heal 40 HP, grant a 50 HP shield, and apply 2 burn stacks to the enemy (15 dmg/stack/turn for 3 turns). Additionally, the next time Phoenix would die, it revives once with 80 HP.

special_move.name: Eternal Flame Surge
special_move.description: Phoenix unleashes the fires of rebirth — a blazing slam that scorches the enemy and ignites the arena with sacred flame!
flavour_texts: 🦅 **Eternal Flame Surge** — the undying Phoenix rises and unleashes the inferno of immortality!
